purpose: Close implementation and evidence gaps for existing research; no new-paper claim.

targets.legacy: Historical campaigns only: stored nominal targets and recomputed assisted boxes.
targets.recomputed: Two Appendix II SDP-derived boxes, intersected with C1/C3-C5; no box-invariance assertion.
targets.source_entry: Recomputed geometry with BOTH velocity half-widths 0.01 rad/s and ankle torque half-width 1 Nm, as in the author entry point. Toe torque/equilibrium remain plant-specific.
targets.common_ankle: Same physical target in every mode: |theta-pi/2|<=0.005 rad, |velocity|<=0.01 rad/s, |human torque|<=1 Nm. This separate matched-task diagnostic is not Table II.

acceptance.interpretation: Operational acceptance chosen before new outcomes; failures remain failures. These thresholds are not claims from the source paper. Region convergence requires all three spatial criteria for the compared pair. Reaching a terminal box is finite-time reach-avoid evidence, not an invariance proof.

timing.selection: First state of each group in the existing frozen 30-state OF protocol, in stored order; all conditions reuse those exact states.
timing.delay_semantics: Commands computed from the current sample are delivered after a fixed delay. Human rate and exo torque share that transport delay; initial rate/device torque are zero. Torque evolves every physics step. No future samples, no rate smoothing, no coverage extrapolation.

paired_models.push_subset: Human upright zero-velocity state only; 0 N is already in the main grid.
paired_models.initialization: Paper ankle lean versus human root lean relative to the identical settled stance. This is a declared perturbation correspondence, not identical multibody states or a transferred HJB guarantee. Each assistance triplet uses identical initial state, hardware mass and human limits.
paired_models.adaptation: Fixed uses no-exo human feedback in every mode. Readapted designs feedback with the device contribution included in the local linearized plant; no outcome-based gain tuning.
paired_models.refinement: Repeat every pair at half the physics timestep, with controller period unchanged.
